R_ISENSE_IN.derivation: Placeholder - depends on current transformer ratio and desired 0-3V output range

R_ISENSE_FB.derivation: Placeholder - sets current sense amplifier gain = 1 + Rf/Rin = 2

R_ISENSE_SERIES.reference: LM358 datasheet SNOSC16D, input protection typical value

C_ISENSE_FILTER.derivation: High-frequency noise filter on current sense input, fc = 1/(2πRC) ≈ 1.6MHz with 1kΩ series resistor
C_ISENSE_FILTER.margin: Well above switching frequency, removes EMI

C_ISENSE_BYPASS.reference: LM358 datasheet SNOSC16D section on supply bypassing

R_VDIV_UPPER.reference: TL431 datasheet SLVS056J Figure 37, voltage divider for feedback

R_VDIV_LOWER.derivation: TL431 regulates REF to 2.5V. For 12V output: Vout × R2/(R1+R2) = 2.5V → R2 = 2.5V × R1 / (Vout - 2.5V) = 2.5 × 10k / 9.5 = 2.63kΩ, nearest E24 = 2.7kΩ

C_COMP_FB.reference: TL431 datasheet SLVS056J Figure 37, Type 2 compensation capacitor
C_COMP_FB.margin: Typical value for voltage loop zero

R_LED_LIMIT.reference: PC817 datasheet, LED forward current I_LED = (Vout - Vf_TL431 - Vf_LED) / R = (12 - 2.5 - 1.2) / 1k = 8.3mA

R_OPTO_PULLUP.reference: PC817 datasheet typical application, collector pull-up for CTR=50% gives ~4mA collector current
R_OPTO_PULLUP.margin: Adequate for TL072 input (pA bias current)

R_ERR_FB.derivation: Placeholder - Type 2 error amplifier feedback resistor, sets DC gain and zero frequency

C_ERR_ZERO.derivation: Placeholder - Type 2 error amplifier zero capacitor, f_zero = 1/(2π × R_ERR_FB × C_ERR_ZERO)

R_ERR_POLE.derivation: Placeholder - Type 2 error amplifier high-frequency pole resistor

C_ERR_POLE.derivation: Placeholder - Type 2 error amplifier high-frequency pole capacitor

R_VCO_TIMING.reference: CD4046 datasheet SCHS097D Figure 13, timing resistor for 100-500kHz range
R_VCO_TIMING.derivation: f = (Vin - 0.5V) / (R × C × VDD). For VDD=15V, R=100k, C=1nF: f(Vin=2V)=100kHz, f(Vin=10V)=633kHz
R_VCO_TIMING.margin: Frequency range 100-633kHz covers LLC resonant range

C_VCO_TIMING.reference: CD4046 datasheet SCHS097D Figure 13, timing capacitor calculated for frequency range

R_VCO_FILTER.derivation: Low-pass filter on VCO input to reduce jitter, fc = 1/(2π × 10k × 10nF) = 1.6kHz
R_VCO_FILTER.margin: Well below switching frequency, filters high-frequency noise

C_VCO_FILTER.derivation: VCO input filter capacitor, fc = 1.6kHz (see R_VCO_FILTER)

R_RAMP_IN.reference: LM358 datasheet Figure 31 integrator circuit, input resistor sets ramp slope dV/dt = Vin/(R×C) = 15V/(100k×10nF) = 1.5 V/µs
R_RAMP_IN.margin: At 250kHz (4µs period): ramp amplitude = 6V (clamped to 5V by diode)

C_RAMP_INTEG.reference: LM358 datasheet Figure 31 integrator circuit, integration capacitor

R_SUM_ISENSE.derivation: Summing resistor for current sense signal, equal values give 1:1 weighting

R_SUM_RAMP.derivation: Summing resistor for slope compensation ramp, matched to R_SUM_ISENSE for equal weighting
R_SUM_RAMP.margin: Slope compensation amplitude = 50% of current sense for stability

R_COMP_PULLUP.reference: LM393 datasheet, open-collector output pull-up resistor

R_COMP_IN_POS.derivation: Input protection resistor for comparator positive input
R_COMP_IN_POS.margin: Limits current in case of overvoltage

R_COMP_IN_NEG.derivation: Input protection resistor for comparator negative input
R_COMP_IN_NEG.margin: Limits current in case of overvoltage

R_LATCH_PULLUP.reference: 74HC74 datasheet, CLR input pull-up (active low, default high)
R_LATCH_PULLUP.margin: Weak pull-up, easily overridden by comparator

R_DEAD_HI.derivation: Dead-time delay: t = R × C × 0.7 = 470Ω × 100pF × 0.7 = 33ns (minimum for GaN FETs)

R_DEAD_LO.derivation: Dead-time delay, matched to R_DEAD_HI for symmetric delays

C_DEAD_LO.derivation: Dead-time delay capacitor, matched to C_DEAD_HI

C_BOOT.reference: IR2110 datasheet PD60147-O Figure 1, bootstrap capacitor C_BOOT ≥ Qg(total) / ΔV_allowed = 10nC / 1V = 10nF, use 100nF for 10× margin

C_VCC_BULK.reference: IR2110 datasheet PD60147-O, bulk capacitor for inrush current during high-side turn-on

C_VCC_BYPASS.reference: IR2110 datasheet PD60147-O, ceramic bypass close to VCC pin

C_VDD_BYPASS.reference: IR2110 datasheet PD60147-O, VDD bypass capacitor close to pin

C_COM_BYPASS.reference: IR2110 datasheet PD60147-O, COM bypass capacitor

R_GATE_HI.derivation: Placeholder - gate series resistor to control dI/dt and reduce ringing, depends on GaN FET Qg and desired rise time
R_GATE_HI.margin: TBD by simulator based on FET characteristics

R_GATE_LO.derivation: Placeholder - gate series resistor for low-side FET, matched to R_GATE_HI

R_PD_HIN.derivation: Pull-down on HIN for noise immunity during startup (not in minimal datasheet schematic but good practice)
R_PD_HIN.margin: Weak pull-down, easily overridden by logic output

R_PD_LIN.derivation: Pull-down on LIN for noise immunity, matched to R_PD_HIN

R_SD_PULLUP.reference: IR2110 datasheet PD60147-O, SD input pull-up (active low shutdown, pulled high for normal operation)
R_SD_PULLUP.margin: Can be overridden by ENABLE signal

D_BOOT.reference: IR2110 datasheet PD60147-O Figure 1, fast recovery diode (trr < 50ns) for bootstrap charging
D_BOOT.margin: UF4007 trr = 75ns (acceptable), consider UF4004 (trr = 35ns) for improvement

D_RAMP_CLAMP.derivation: Fast switching diode to clamp ramp output at +5V, prevents saturation of integrator
D_RAMP_CLAMP.margin: Small signal diode adequate for low-current clamp

Q_RAMP_RESET.derivation: Small-signal N-channel MOSFET for ramp reset switch, driven by 74HC14 output (0-15V)
Q_RAMP_RESET.margin: Low Qg for fast switching, discharges 10nF integration cap in <10ns
